description: This source file defines the CachedCatalogViewModelService class, which implements ICatalogViewModelService by adding caching functionality over an underlying CatalogViewModelService. It provides methods to retrieve brand and type lists, as well as catalog items, with caching to improve performance.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A caching wrapper around CatalogViewModelService implementing ICatalogViewModelService to provide cached access to catalog data.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves the list of brands, using cache to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves catalog items with pagination and filters, utilizing cache for performance.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of product types, with caching.
